title: Critter Safari/Bells
wikitext:
* '''{{Coordinates|-68|66|-43}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden on the bottom of an ice platform near the entrance to the {{Blue|Icy}} biome. Jumping on the platform repeatedly will cause it to flip over, yielding the ''{{Ach|What the flip?!}}'' secret achievement. The bell will be too cold to ring, requiring an {{Item|Icebreaker}} to break it.
* '''{{Coordinates|-96|46|-57}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden behind a bed found in an underground cavern in the underwater lake in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome.
* '''{{Coordinates|-4|96|-42}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden on the roof of the mansion in the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome. It can be accessed from parkour from the bottom of the mansion, or from climbing to the top of the {{Blue|Icy}} biome and jumping into the roof.
* '''{{Coordinates|47|55|-7}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the edge of the '''Critter Safari''', accessed from the {{DarkGreen|Forest}} biome waterfalls, before dropping down and walking towards the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome while on the outer rim of the '''Critter Safari'''. The ledge can be exited safely by ascending from the vine at {{Coordinates|16|53|79}}.
* '''{{Coordinates|-30|125|59}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden near the top of the {{DarkGreen|Forest}} biome, requiring parkour across a large tree to a floating island.
* '''{{Coordinates|-90|109|16}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the top of the {{Gold|Cavern}} biome: you will need to climb from a fake cactus onto a large stack from {{coords|-138|102|26}}, parkour across a tree, and make it to another stack where the bell is found.
* '''{{Coordinates|-50|81|0}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the top of the landing zone, accessible from an ice spike by the entrance to the {{Blue|Icy}} biome.

Each bell corresponds to a specific color in the rainbow. Completing the rainbow and returning to the landing zone yields the following dialogue from {{NPCSprite|"Hunter" Tobias}}:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6"Hunter" Tobias&f: Uh guys, you better come and see this...}}

Finally, a cutscene plays as the player walks into the landing zone. As the player looks at the rainbow, the following dialogue plays:
<center>{{Rmt|&fWow, a &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&f. I haven't seen one of them in a long time. Isn't it beautiful?/&fYou know, there are so many memories in a &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&f./&fI remember seeing one while playing with all my friends, back when we were very small./&fThe next time I saw one was many years later, after one of them died./&fSometimes it feels like, every time I see one, there are less of my kind left to see it with me./&fBut it's still oddly comforting./&fBefore I was here, there were &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f./&fAfter I am gone, there will still be &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f./&fThroughout my short life, everything I once knew has changed beyond recognition./&fAs for the &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f, I don't think they notice the difference.}}</center>

With each dialogue, the player's {{Attr|Miracle Chance}} attribute gains {{Green|+1}} level, maxing out upon the cutscene ending. Players also receive ''{{ach|The Miracle in a sunbeam}}'' secret achievement.

During this cutscene, a custom [[Hypixel SkyBlock OST|song]] plays:

[[File:Safari Rainbug.ogg]]
